editorial_rules: Every prediction is tied to one market row captured from OLBG on 2026-10-26 and states the selection, the market and our own price.
Form and standings numbers are only used where they were read off an official league page during this session (NHL.com, NBA.com). Those rows carry an official source link.
No injury, team-news, weather or head-to-head claim is made anywhere: none could be checked against an official source from this environment, so the field is left empty rather than guessed.
Where no independent check was possible the prediction says so in plain words instead of implying research that was not done.
Confidence labels come from scripts/price_model.py: HIGH needs at least 8 tips on the market and a modelled chance of 62% or better.

Golf.reason: OLBG lists three tournaments and only four tipster-backed selections (two tips in each). A five-pick golf card would require inventing support that does not exist.

Rugby Union.reason: Five picks delivered, but every rugby union match market on the card carries one or two tips, so all five are Low confidence.

Snooker.reason: OLBG's snooker page returned 'No tips found.' on 2026-10-26. No fixtures, no markets, no tips - so no lines and no picks. This is not a gap in our research; there is nothing on the site to price.

Darts.reason: Only two darts events exist on the card, both outright tournament markets. No match markets are published.

Baseball.reason: One MLB game carries tips. Three markets were priced on it; the money line fell inside -250 so the run line was picked.

Gaelic Sports.reason: Two club football matches plus two 2027 championship outrights (football and hurling). That is the whole Gaelic card.

Greyhounds.reason: Eight races listed, one already expired. Seven were priceable, five picked. Every race carries a single tip except two, so all are Low.

Tennis.reason: Tournament names are not published on the OLBG tennis list, so competition is blank for every row.

Motor Racing.reason: Two events: the Mexico City GP (a top-six finish market with no tip count printed) and the 2026 Drivers' Championship without Kimi Antonelli. Only the second is priceable.

Handball.reason: Fourteen of fifteen matches show 'Tie' as the most popular selection, which is a market-mapping anomaly rather than genuine support. Only the two rows with a named team were eligible.

Ice Hockey.reason: The richest book on the site: NHL plus SHL, Liiga and DEL, with several five-market event pages.

Rugby League.reason: No rugby league matches are listed. The only events are three 2027 outrights (State of Origin, Super League, NRL).
